grains.RAW.HOLDINGS: one row per sukuk holding (one sukuk series serviced by one fictional custodian)
grains.RAW.HOLDING_DAILY: one row per holding per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.HOLDING_DOCUMENTS: one row per holding (holding file document snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.escalation_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(a settlement break on the holding is escalated to custodian investigation in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day portfolio-wide settlement-break FORECAST; auto-match failure rate ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.BREAK_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic break-handling SOPs (one per sukuk type and break reason)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.SUKUK_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.SUKUK_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, holding, break-reason and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (holdings, daily settlement breaks, escalations by holding, escalation risk, settlement events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_SETTLEMENTS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_BREAK_ALERT logs new BREAK events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
